title: String output produces text-only tool result (backward compat)
preconditions: ToolPartData has output: string, no contentParts field
test_data: PartRow with tool type, output='hello world', no contentParts
steps: Create a user + assistant MessageRow pair
Create a tool PartRow with output: 'hello world' (plain string)
Find the ToolModelMessage (role === 'tool') in the result
expected_result: content[0].output equals { type: 'text', value: 'hello world' } — unchanged from current behaviour
notes: Backward-compat guard. Must pass both before and after the feature lands.

title: contentParts present → output shape switches to content-type
preconditions: ToolPartData has contentParts: ToolResultContentPart[] with text + image
test_data: contentParts = [{ type: 'text', text: 'Screenshot captured.' }, { type: 'image-data', data: 'base64encodedpngdata', mediaType: 'image/png' }]
steps: Create a user + assistant MessageRow pair
Create a tool PartRow with output: 'Screenshot captured.' AND contentParts array
Find the ToolModelMessage in the result
expected_result: content[0].output equals { type: 'content', value: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Screenshot captured.' }, { type: 'image-data', data: 'base64encodedpngdata', mediaType: 'image/png' }] }
notes: Core new behaviour. Fails until toModelMessages content-branch is implemented.

title: Mixed text + image contentParts faithfully forwarded in order
preconditions: contentParts has 3 items: text, image-data, text
test_data: contentParts = [text:'Page rendered.', image-data:'AAAAPNGdata==', text:'DOM is stable.']
steps: Create a tool PartRow with 3-item contentParts
expected_result: value has length 3; items match input contentParts in exact order
notes: Order preservation is critical for model understanding.

title: Text-only contentParts still produces content-type output
preconditions: contentParts is present but contains only { type: 'text' } items — no images
test_data: contentParts = [{ type: 'text', text: 'Only text here, no image.' }]
steps: Create a tool PartRow with text-only contentParts
expected_result: output.type === 'content' (not 'text') because contentParts array drives the branch, not the presence of images
notes: Presence of contentParts field — regardless of its contents — must trigger the content branch.

title: Multiple tool calls in one turn — string and contentParts each routed independently
preconditions: Two tool parts in one assistant message: one with string output, one with contentParts
test_data: Tool 'read' with string output + tool 'screenshot' with contentParts
steps: Create two tool PartRows under the same assistant message
Assert both appear in a single ToolModelMessage
Check each tool result's output format independently
expected_result: text tool → { type: 'text', value: '...' }; image tool → { type: 'content', value: [...] }
notes: Both formats must coexist in one ToolModelMessage.content array.

title: Error tool result with contentParts uses error text path, ignores contentParts
preconditions: ToolPartData.status === 'error', error field set, contentParts present
steps: Create an error tool PartRow that also has contentParts
expected_result: output equals { type: 'text', value: 'Error: Browser crashed' } — error always wins over contentParts
notes: Error handling must not be disrupted by the presence of contentParts.

title: String tool output stored as-is — no contentParts field in ToolPartData
test_data: toolPartString helper with output='plain text result'
steps: Build a PartRow via toolPartString helper
notes: Baseline persistence contract. No change expected.

title: ContentPart[] output — .output holds text-only extraction, .contentParts holds full array
preconditions: Tool returns ToolResultContentPart[] with text + image
test_data: contentParts = [text:'Tool says hello.', image-data:'abc123==', text:'And goodbye.']
steps: Build a PartRow via toolPartWithContentParts helper
Verify data.contentParts is the full array
expected_result: data.output === 'Tool says hello. And goodbye.' (string); data.contentParts.length === 3 with full part objects
notes: Dual storage: string for UI/search, full array for LLM replay.

title: Image-only ContentPart[] — .output is empty string
preconditions: ContentPart[] contains only image-data parts, no text
steps: Build a PartRow with image-only contentParts and output: ''
expected_result: data.output === '' (empty string); data.contentParts has the image part
notes: Edge case: no text to extract.

title: ToolResultContentPart type discriminant exhaustiveness
test_data: { type: 'text', text: 'hello' } and { type: 'image-data', data: 'b64', mediaType: 'image/png' }
steps: Run discriminant narrowing function over both
expected_result: Both types narrow correctly; describe() returns 'text:hello' and 'image:image/png'
notes: TypeScript compile-time and runtime discriminant validation.

title: Compaction prunes contentParts alongside output for completed tool parts
preconditions: ToolPartData with status='completed', output='Screenshot captured.', contentParts=[text, image-data]
test_data: Simulated prunedData construction from anchored.ts pruning logic
steps: Simulate prunedData: set output='[output pruned for compaction]', contentParts=undefined
expected_result: prunedData.output === '[output pruned for compaction]'; prunedData.contentParts === undefined
notes: Images must not survive compaction boundaries.

title: Compaction does NOT prune pending/running tool parts
steps: Verify data would be copied as-is
expected_result: isPrunable === false; data copied verbatim without any pruning
notes: Status guard must cover only terminal states.

title: Pruned tool part (no contentParts) falls back to text-type in toModelMessages
preconditions: ToolPartData after compaction pruning: output='[output pruned for compaction]', no contentParts
test_data: prunedData = { status: 'completed', output: '[output pruned for compaction]', no contentParts }
steps: Build a PartRow from pruned ToolPartData
expected_result: output equals { type: 'text', value: '[output pruned for compaction]' } — falls back to string path
notes: Round-trip: compacted session's tool parts should reconstruct correctly.

title: Compaction prunes contentParts for error-status tool parts too
preconditions: ToolPartData with status='error', error field set, contentParts=[image-data]
test_data: { status: 'error', error: 'Process timed out', contentParts: [image-data part] }
steps: Simulate prunedData: output='[output pruned for compaction]', contentParts=undefined
notes: Error text is preserved for debugging; only image data is freed.

title: String still satisfies ToolResult.output after union type change
preconditions: ToolResult type updated to output: string | ToolResultContentPart[]
steps: Assign a string to ToolResultOutput type alias
expected_result: No TypeScript error; runtime typeof check passes
notes: Backward compatibility must be preserved — all existing tools return strings.

title: ToolResultContentPart[] satisfies ToolResult.output
preconditions: ToolResult type updated to output: string | ToolResultContentPart[]
steps: Assign an array to ToolResultOutput type alias
expected_result: No TypeScript error; array check passes; element type correct
notes: New union arm must be assignable without type errors.

title: Runtime Array.isArray correctly discriminates string from ContentPart[]
